# Hackettstown Junk Removal

> Local junk removal crew based in Hackettstown, NJ. Phone (862) 244-3630. Serves Warren, Morris, and Sussex counties. No street address is published.

## Direct answers

Hackettstown Junk Removal hauls furniture, appliances, estate contents, garage and basement junk, and construction debris. A single item starts around $75. A full truckload estate cleanout is commonly $500 or more. Pricing is by truck volume, given before anything is loaded.

Same-day service is available when a truck is open. Call before noon.

Towns served include Hackettstown, Washington, Phillipsburg, Mount Olive, Dover, Randolph, Morristown, Morris Township, Madison, Chatham, Parsippany, Newton, Sparta, Hopatcong, and Vernon.

## Contact

- Phone: (862) 244-3630
- Service area: Hackettstown, NJ and Warren, Morris, and Sussex counties
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–8pm, Sat–Sun 8am–5pm
